[[The Fury]] is a general of [[Dhuum]] and one of the four [[Lords of Anguish]] who was imprisoned within [[the Foundry of Failed Creations]]. When it broke free, it took control of the prison in service to [[Abaddon]] to use the area as a staging attack to send forces through the [[Door of Komalie]]. Later, it oversaw the attacks on [[Shing Jea Island]] during the [[Dragon Festival]]. After Abaddon's defeat, he worked to gain [[Mallyx the Unyielding]]'s favor.

The Fury spawns with several [[Guardian of Komalie|Guardians of Komalie]] after [[the Black Beast of Arrgh]] has been killed.
